aiAdvisor.bannerDesc: Automated pattern analysis for sudden atmospheric variations & planned shifts
aiAdvisor.microClimateDesc: No sudden micro-climate disturbances detected in the 6-hour forecast window.
aiAdvisor.dialogDesc: Predictive pattern analytics for sudden shifts, lifestyle planning & advisory for {cityName}
aiAdvisor.stabilityHigh: Atmospheric stability is high. No sudden cold fronts, squalls, or rapid precipitation onset detected.
aiAdvisor.quickQuestionUmbrella: Should I carry an umbrella today?
aiAdvisor.quickQuestionWear: What should I wear right now?
aiAdvisor.chatPlaceholder: Ask AI about commute, apparel, rain window...
aiAdvisor.answerUmbrellaYes: Yes, keep an umbrella handy. Precipitation probability exceeds 35% around {time}.
aiAdvisor.answerUmbrellaNo: Precipitation probability is below 20% for the next 12 hours. You likely do not need an umbrella.
aiAdvisor.answerWearCold: It is currently {temp}°{unit}. We recommend a warm insulated coat or fleece jacket, long trousers, and closed-toe footwear.
aiAdvisor.answerWearHot: It is currently {temp}°{unit}. Wear light, breathable clothing (linen/cotton), UV-protection sunglasses, and apply sunscreen.
aiAdvisor.answerWearMild: It is a mild {temp}°{unit}. Comfortable layers (a light cardigan, hoodie, or windbreaker over a t-shirt) are ideal.
aiAdvisor.answerExercise: The best window for outdoor exercise is around {time}, with cooler temperatures ({temp}°{unit}) and lower thermal stress.
aiAdvisor.answerTomorrow: Tomorrow in {city}: {desc}. High of {high}°{unit}, low of {low}°{unit}, and a {pop}% chance of rain.
aiAdvisor.answerTomorrowFallback: Tomorrow is expected to remain consistent with current synoptic trends.
aiAdvisor.answerWeekend: Weekend synoptic outlook: Saturday ({satDesc}, max {satHigh}°{unit}), Sunday ({sunDesc}, max {sunHigh}°{unit}).
aiAdvisor.answerWeekendFallback: The extended weekend forecast will be available as we approach the end of the week.
aiAdvisor.answerGeneral: Synoptic evaluation for {city}: Atmospheric pressure is {pressure} with humidity at {humidity}%. Condition is {desc}. Expected 24-hour diurnal range is {min}° to {max}°{unit}.
aiAdvisor.suddenRainDetail: Precipitation probability surges from {start}% to {end}% at approximately {time}.
aiAdvisor.suddenRainAction: Take an umbrella and plan for wet transit conditions.
aiAdvisor.rapidCoolingDetail: Temperatures will drop by {drop}°{unit} within {hours} hours.
aiAdvisor.rapidCoolingAction: Carry a sweater or jacket if staying out past twilight.
aiAdvisor.windSurgeDetail: Strong wind gusts up to {gust} m/s detected around {time}.
aiAdvisor.windSurgeAction: Secure outdoor furniture and watch for crosswinds during highway transit.
aiAdvisor.weekendSummaryRain: Expect sporadic precipitation with temperatures hovering around {temp}°{unit}.
aiAdvisor.weekendSummaryDry: Expect favorable synoptic stability with temperatures hovering around {temp}°{unit}.
aiAdvisor.clothingMild: Light layers with comfortable breathable clothing.
aiAdvisor.clothingCold: Thermal insulated jacket, scarf, and layered garments advised.
aiAdvisor.clothingHot: Ultra-light breathable fabrics, wide-brim hat, and sunglasses recommended.
aiAdvisor.clothingRain: Waterproof outer shell or compact umbrella essential.
aiAdvisor.sportSuperb: Superb conditions for outdoor running, cycling, or recreation.
aiAdvisor.sportAcceptable: Acceptable outdoor conditions; schedule activities before precipitation onset.
aiAdvisor.sportAdverse: Adverse meteorological conditions; indoor training recommended.
aiAdvisor.commuteRain: Expect vehicular congestion and slick pavement during peak transit intervals.
aiAdvisor.commuteDry: Dry conditions with nominal transit predictability across the city grid.
aiAdvisor.summarySteady: Atmospheric equilibrium is currently steady across the short-range trajectory.
